div.head: II Eg 2
div.ab: Gyf hwa þonne ðegna sý, ðe on his bóclande cyrican habbe, þe legerstow on sy, gesylle he þane þriddan dæl his agenre teoðunge into his cyrican.
Gif hwa þonne þegena sy, þe on his boclande cyricean hæbbe, ðe legerstow on sy, gesylle ðone ðriddan dæl his agenre teoþunge into his cyricean.
Gif hwa þonne þegna sy, þe on his boclande circan hæbbe, þe legerstow on sy, gesylle þone þriddan dæl his agenra teoðunga into his circan.
Si quis tainorum sit, qui in feudo suo ecclesiam habeat, ubi cimiterium sit, dęt ei tertiam partem decime sue.
[Be cyricsceat.] Gif hwa þonne þegna sy þe on his boclande circan hæbbe þe legerstow on sy, gesylle þone þriddan dæl his agenra teoðunga into his circan.
Gyf hwa þonne ðegna sy ðe on his boclande cyrican habbe, þe legerstow on sy, gesylle he þane þriddan dæl his agenre teoðunge into his cyrican.

(Von Kirchensteuer. Ld) Wenn [es] aber einer der Adligen ist, der auf seinem kraft Urkundenprivilegs besessenen Lande eine Kirche hat, an der ein Friedhof liegt, so zahle er ein Drittel des auf ihm [lastenden] Zehnten an [diese] seine Kirche [und zwei Drittel der alten Pfarre].

(Of church-dues. Ld) But if it is one of the thegns who has on his bookland a church at which there is a graveyard, let him pay a third of the tithe [owed] by him to [this] his church [and two thirds to the old minster].
If, however, there is a thegn who, on the land which he holds by title-deed, has a church to which is attached a graveyard, he shall pay the third part of his own tithes to his church.
If, however, there is any thegn who has on his bookland a church with which there is a graveyard, he is to pay the third part of his own tithes into his church.
Yet if there is a thane who has a church possessing a graveyard on land he holds by charter, he is to give one-third of his own tithes to his church.
